privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1p1: The service collects the following personal information during account registration and use.
privacy.s1p2: When signing in via social login (Google, Kakao, Naver): name, email address, profile image (optional).
privacy.s2Title: 2. Purpose of Collecting and Using Personal Information
privacy.s2p1: The service uses collected personal information for the following purposes.
privacy.s2p2: Member identification and service provision, management of wishlist and report history, statistical analysis for service improvement.
privacy.s3Title: 3. Retention and Use Period of Personal Information
privacy.s3p1: Personal information is destroyed without delay upon account deletion or once the purpose of collection and use has been achieved.
privacy.s3p2: However, information may be retained for the required period if preservation is necessary under applicable laws.
privacy.s4Title: 4. Disclosure of Personal Information to Third Parties
privacy.s4p1: The service does not disclose users' personal information to third parties in principle. Exceptions apply when required by law or requested by investigative authorities.
privacy.s5p1: The service delegates personal information processing to Supabase (database and authentication services) for smooth operations. Updates to the delegation scope and processors will be announced upon changes to this policy.
privacy.s6p1: Users may access, modify, or request deletion of their personal information at any time through account deletion.
